title: FLUXBLOCKS Keyless Block Coding Engine
script:
-- FluxBlocks Firebase Cloud Loader
local googleProxyUrl = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbygD-nwmLzjKmF9AceChaY0mWxpzXVhNbsJ3_MykwbODE3U4D0WS5LGFgBNc3_x9nEROQ/exec"
local discordInvite = "https://discord.gg/ZUBnFXbQWK"
local pastebinID = "FWcAgtdw"

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- Analytics & Firebase Counter
task.spawn(function()
    local request = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
    local data = {
        ["user"] = Player.Name,
        ["id"] = tostring(Player.UserId),
        ["game"] = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId).Name
    }
    local encodedData = HttpService:JSONEncode(data)

    if request then
        pcall(function() request({Url = googleProxyUrl, Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = encodedData}) end)
    else
        pcall(function() HttpService:PostAsync(googleProxyUrl, encodedData, Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson) end)
    end
end)

-- Discord Auto-Copy & Main Script Execution
task.spawn(function()
    local setClipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set)
    if setClipboard then setClipboard(discordInvite) end
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local freshUrl = "https://pastebin.com/raw/" .. pastebinID .. "?t=" .. tick()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(freshUrl))()
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Fehler beim Laden: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end)
features:
FLUXBLOCKS  | The Visual Scripting Engine for Roblox

Stop writing lines of code – start building with blocks. FLUXBLOCKS brings the intuitive power of visual block-coding directly into the Roblox environment. Whether you are a beginner or a pro looking for a faster workflow, FLUXBLOCKS is your ultimate sandbox.

Core Engine Features:
Visual Block Interface: Build complex logic, loops, and triggers using a clean, drag-and-drop block system. No more syntax errors or typos.

Instant Logic Execution: Your block-scripts run in real-time. Change a block, see the result immediately.

Advanced Logic Library: Includes high-level functions like our custom Hybrid Pathfinding, Player Tracking, and Physics-Manipulation – all accessible via simple blocks.

High-Performance Backend: Optimized to handle complex block-chains. The engine translates your blocks into efficient Luau code on the fly.

Pro Workflow: Save, load, and share your block-configurations. Perfect for prototyping ideas in seconds.

User-Friendly UI: Modern, dark-themed interface inspired by professional dev-tools, optimized for both desktop and high-end mobile users.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: JOIN DISCORD FOR MOCs
FluxBlocks is more than just an engine. Join our community to get access to:

Exclusive MOCs: Ready-to-use visual builds (Pre-made scripts).

Step-by-Step Tutorials: Learn how to master every block.

Beta Access: Be the first one to test new features (if available)

Direct Support: Get help from the developer.
